title: GitHub - micro/mu: Tools for Agents
excerpt: Tools for Agents. Contribute to micro/mu development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
Tools for agents

Overview

Mu is an MCP server and web app for agents and humans. It provides access to the real world through MCP for the agents and let's humans browse or interact with same content in a web app. Access news, web search, mail, markets, weather, video, places, images, files, calendar, contacts and more.

Use it live at micro.mu, or self-host.

Usage

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mu": {
      "url": "https://micro.mu/mcp"
    }
  }
}

Create a Personal Access Token at /token and send it as Authorization: Bearer.

curl -X POST https://micro.mu/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'

Scope the connection to the services you need:

https://micro.mu/mcp?tools=news,web,mail

That's what gets listed to your agent. Everything else is still callable.

Browse the tools: micro.mu/tools — every tool, grouped by service, with what each call costs.

See MCP docs for the protocol details.

The tools

Grouped the way /tools and the sidebar group them — one row per service, named for it.

Area Tools
Apps apps_build · apps_create · apps_edit · apps_fork · apps_read · apps_run · apps_search · apps_test — build and run small web tools
Blog blog_create · blog_read · blog_list · blog_update · blog_delete — publish, with AI-generated daily digests
Chat chat — one question, one answer
Contacts contacts_add · contacts_find · contacts_list · contacts_delete — turn a name into an address
Events events_create · events_free · events_list — schedule, and find when you are free
Files files_put · files_get · files_list · files_share · files_delete — keep a file, get a URL
Images images_generate · images_search
Index index_search — everything this instance holds for you
Islam islam_today · islam_prayer · islam_qibla — daily reminder, prayer times, qibla
Mail mail_inbox · mail_send · mail_address — a real SMTP server with DKIM, and an address per agent
Markets markets_list — stocks, crypto, futures, commodities, currencies
News news_list · news_read · news_search — RSS aggregation, full articles
Places places_search · places_nearby · places_eta — points of interest, geocoding, travel time
Search web_search · web_fetch — search the web, read a page as clean text
Social social_list · social_search — public threads and replies
Storage db_create · db_get · db_list · db_delete — per-caller records (db_create with an id updates)
Stream stream_list · stream_post — this instance's own timeline
Video video_list · video_search — curated channels, no ads or recommendations
Wallet wallet_balance — credits, and where to send USDC to top up
Weather weather_forecast — conditions, forecast, pollen
Platform agent — ask the whole thing a question and let it compose. Also quran · quran_search · hadith, save · unsave · saved_list, and flag · dismiss · block_user · unblock_user

Request a tool

Open an issue and say what it should do.

The app

The server includes a web app with a home screen. Cards render each service at a glance (headlines, prices, weather, unread mail) and the agent sits inline to act on what you're looking at. Logged-out visitors get a public version with live data.

An LLM — Claude, Atlas Cloud (DeepSeek), or a local Ollama / OpenAI-compatible endpoint — calls the services as tools, composes answers, and keeps per-user memory across sessions.

Sign in with a username and password, a passkey (WebAuthn), or Google. For the CLI, generate a Personal Access Token at /token.

CLI

Every tool is a mu subcommand. The same binary runs the server (mu --serve) and the CLI.

mu news_list                            # latest headlines
mu news_search "ai safety"              # search news
mu web_search "claude code"             # search the web
mu agent "what is the btc price?"       # run the full agent
mu weather_forecast --lat 51.5 --lon -0.12
mu wallet                               # your balance
mu help                                 # full tool list

The CLI is registry-driven — a tool added to the server automatically becomes a CLI command.

mu login                  # opens /token in your browser, paste the PAT back
mu config set token xxx   # or set it directly
export MU_TOKEN=xxx       # or use the environment

See CLI docs.

Discord & Telegram

Talk to the agent from Discord or Telegram — questions, markets, news, all from chat. Join the Discord

Discord: /agent, /news, /markets, /weather, /mail, /social, /blog, /video, /search, /apps, /balance, /usage. Telegram: /agent, /ask, /news, /markets, /weather, /usage.

Setup for both is in Installation.

Self-hosting

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/micro/mu/main/install.sh | sh
# Docker
git clone https://github.com/micro/mu && cd mu
docker compose up

# From source
git clone https://github.com/micro/mu
cd mu && go install
mu --serve

First-run setup

Open http://localhost:8080 and Mu walks you through a one-time setup: create your admin account and pick an AI provider (Claude, Atlas Cloud, or a local Ollama / OpenAI-compatible endpoint). That's enough to have a working agent.

For terminal setup. Configure the provider headless, then start the server:

mu setup        # pick a provider, paste a key
mu --serve      # first account you create becomes admin

Or set everything by hand:

export ADMIN=you@example.com          # who's admin (else: first account)
export ATLAS_API_KEY=xxx              # or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or OPENAI_BASE_URL
mu --serve

Once you're admin, every other key (YouTube, Brave search, weather, mail/DKIM, Google sign-in…) is configurable from /admin/env in the browser.

See Installation guide.

Configuration

Customise feeds, prompts and cards by editing JSON files:

  • service/news/feeds.json — RSS news feeds
  • service/chat/prompts.json — chat topics
  • home/cards.json — home screen cards
  • service/video/channels.json — YouTube channels
  • service/places/locations.json — saved locations

See Environment Variables for all options.

Documentation

Full docs in the docs folder. Start with MCP for agents, Architecture for the code. The live tool catalogue is at /tools.

License

AGPL-3.0 — use, modify, distribute. If you run a modified version as a service, share the source.

content_html_zh:
代理工具

概述

Mu 是面向代理和人类的 MCP 服务器和 Web 应用程序。 它通过 MCP 为代理提供对现实世界的访问，让人们在 Web 应用程序中浏览或与相同内容进行交互。 访问新闻、网络搜索、邮件、市场、天气、视频、地点、图像、文件、日历、联系人等。

在 micro.mu 上实时使用它，或自行托管。

Usage

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mu": {
      "url": "https://micro.mu/mcp"
    }
  }
}

在 /token 处创建个人访问令牌并将其作为授权：承载者发送。

curl -X POST https://micro.mu/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'

确定与您需要的服务的连接范围：

https://micro.mu/mcp?tools=news,web,mail

这就是向您的代理人列出的内容。 其他一切仍然可以调用。

浏览工具：micro.mu/tools — 每个工具均按服务分组，以及每次调用的费用。

有关协议详细信息，请参阅 MCP 文档。

工具

按 /tools 和侧边栏对它们进行分组的方式进行分组 - 每个服务一行，并以此命名。

Area Tools
Apps apps_build · apps_create · apps_edit · apps_fork · apps_read · apps_run · apps_search · apps_test — 构建和运行小型网络工具
Blog blog_create · blog_read · blog_list · blog_update · blog_delete — 发布，包含人工智能生成的每日摘要
Chat 聊天——一个问题，一个答案
联系方式 contacts_add ·contacts_find ·contacts_list ·contacts_delete — 将姓名转换为地址
活动 events_create · events_free · events_list — 日程安排，并查找您何时有空
Files files_put · files_get · files_list · files_share · files_delete — 保留文件，获取 URL
图片 图像生成 · 图像搜索
Index index_search — 该实例为您提供的所有内容
Islam islam_today · islam_prayer · islam_qibla — 每日提醒、祈祷时间、朝拜
Mail mail_inbox · mail_send · mail_address — 具有 DKIM 的真实 SMTP 服务器，以及每个代理的地址
市场 market_list — 股票、加密货币、期货、商品、货币
News news_list · news_read · news_search — RSS 聚合，完整文章
地点 places_search·places_nearby·places_eta — 兴趣点、地理编码、旅行时间
搜索 web_search · web_fetch — 搜索网络，以纯文本形式读取页面
社会的 Social_list · Social_search — 公共话题和回复
贮存 db_create · db_get · db_list · db_delete — 每个调用者记录（带有 id 更新的 db_create）
溪流 stream_list·stream_post — 该实例自己的时间线
Video video_list · video_search — 精选频道，无广告或推荐
钱包 wallet_balance — 积分，以及发送 USDC 充值的位置
天气 Weather_forecast — 状况、预报、花粉
平台 代理人——向整个事情提出一个问题，然后让它组成。 还有《古兰经》·古兰经搜索·圣训、保存·取消保存·saved_list 和标记·解雇·block_user·unblock_user

索取工具

打开一个问题并说出它应该做什么。

该应用程序

该服务器包括一个带有主屏幕的网络应用程序。 卡片让每项服务一目了然（标题、价格、天气、未读邮件），而客服人员会根据您所看到的内容采取行动。 注销的访问者可以获得包含实时数据的公共版本。

LLM（Claude、Atlas Cloud (DeepSeek) 或本地 Ollama/OpenAI 兼容端点）将服务作为工具调用、编写答案并在会话中保留每个用户的内存。

使用用户名和密码、密钥 (WebAuthn) 或 Google 登录。 对于 CLI，在 /token 处生成个人访问令牌。

CLI

每个工具都是一个 mu 子命令。 相同的二进制文件运行服务器 (mu --serve) 和 CLI。

mu news_list                            # latest headlines
mu news_search "ai safety"              # search news
mu web_search "claude code"             # search the web
mu agent "what is the btc price?"       # run the full agent
mu weather_forecast --lat 51.5 --lon -0.12
mu wallet                               # your balance
mu help                                 # full tool list

CLI 是注册表驱动的——添加到服务器的工具会自动成为 CLI 命令。

mu login                  # opens /token in your browser, paste the PAT back
mu config set token xxx   # or set it directly
export MU_TOKEN=xxx       # or use the environment

请参阅 CLI 文档。

不和谐和电报

通过 Discord 或 Telegram 与代理交谈 — 问题、市场、新闻，全部通过聊天进行。 加入不和谐

不和谐：/agent、/news、/markets、/weather、/mail、/social、/blog、/video、/search、/apps、/balance、/usage。 电报：/agent、/ask、/news、/markets、/weather、/usage。

两者的设置都在安装中。

自托管

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/micro/mu/main/install.sh | sh
# Docker
git clone https://github.com/micro/mu && cd mu
docker compose up

# From source
git clone https://github.com/micro/mu
cd mu && go install
mu --serve

首次运行设置

打开 http://localhost:8080，Mu 将引导您完成一次性设置：创建管理员帐户并选择 AI 提供商（Claude、Atlas Cloud 或本地 Ollama/OpenAI 兼容端点）。 有一个工作代理就足够了。

用于终端设置。 配置无头提供程序，然后启动服务器：

mu setup        # pick a provider, paste a key
mu --serve      # first account you create becomes admin

或者手动设置一切：

export ADMIN=you@example.com          # who's admin (else: first account)
export ATLAS_API_KEY=xxx              # or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or OPENAI_BASE_URL
mu --serve

一旦您成为管理员，所有其他键（YouTube、Brave 搜索、天气、邮件/DKIM、Google 登录...） 可以在浏览器中的 /admin/env 进行配置。

请参阅安装指南。

配置

通过编辑 JSON 文件来自定义提要、提示和卡片：

  • service/news/feeds.json — RSS 新闻提要
  • service/chat/prompts.json — 聊天主题
  • home/cards.json — 主屏幕卡
  • service/video/channels.json — YouTube 频道
  • service/places/locations.json — 保存的位置

有关所有选项，请参阅环境变量。

文档

完整文档位于 docs 文件夹中。 从代理的 MCP 开始，代码的架构开始。 实时工具目录位于 /tools。

执照

AGPL-3.0 — 使用、修改、分发。 如果您将修改后的版本作为服务运行，请共享源代码。
